Acme news

News: Acme Pay has built card payment terminals for merchants across Egypt since 2014, and this page describes how the company handles news for customers and partners.

Every statement here is written by the Acme Pay team in Cairo and reviewed each quarter so that merchants, investors and regulators can rely on the same facts about news.

If a figure changes during the year, the news section is updated in place and the date of the change is kept on the page for anyone who needs to check the history.
